You can pay LP in multiples of 500, then for every 500 LP paid, target 1 of your "Mystical Shine Ball" that is banished or in your GY; Special Summon them, but place them on the bottom of the Deck when they leave the field. You can only use 1 "The Agent of Destruction - Venus" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Xyz Wrath
cards.desc: Once per turn, when a Level 5 or higher monster's effect is activated (except during the Damage Step), and you control an Xyz Monster: You can discard 1 card; negate the effect, and if you do, destroy that monster.

cards.name: Esper Girl
cards.desc: When this removed from play card is Special Summoned, remove from play the top card of your Deck, face-down. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, add that removed card to your hand.

cards.name: D - Time
cards.desc: When a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control leaves the field: Add 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand whose Level is less than or equal to that "Elemental HERO" monster's original Level.

cards.name: Blooming of the Darkest Rose
cards.desc: Special Summon "Rose Tokens" (Plant/DARK/Level 2/ATK 800/DEF 800) in Defense Position to either field, up to the combined number of cards in the Field Zones and Field Spells in the GYs. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Black Rose Dragon", or 1 Plant monster, in your Monster Zone; banish it, and if you do, place this card on the bottom of the Deck. During the next Standby Phase, return that banished monster to the field. You can only use this effect of "Blooming of the Darkest Rose" once per turn.

cards.name: Security Dragon
cards.desc:
2 monsters
Once while face-up on the field, if this card is co-linked: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; return it to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Security Dragon" once per turn.

cards.name: Hyper Psychic Riser
cards.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Monsters with less ATK than this card cannot attack, also neither player can activate the effects of face-up monsters on the field with more ATK than this card. If this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY: You can target 1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner monster in your GY with the same Type and Attribute as each other; add them to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Hyper Psychic Riser" once per turn.

cards.name: Swordsoul Strife
cards.desc: If a card(s) is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can banish 1 Wyrm Synchro Monster or 1 "Swordsoul" card from your hand, Deck, GY, or that is face-up on either field. If this card is banished: You can Special Summon 1 "Swordsoul Token" (Wyrm/Tuner/WATER/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 0). While that Token is in the Monster Zone, the player who Summoned it cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use each effect of "Swordsoul Strife" once per turn.

cards.name: Naturia Antjaw
cards.desc: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), you can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Naturia" monster from your Deck.

cards.name: Ragnaraika the Evil Seed
cards.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 1 Insect, Plant, or Reptile monster from your hand to the GY. You can only Special Summon "Ragnaraika the Evil Seed" once per turn this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add to your hand up to 2 different "Ragnaraika" cards of yours that are banished and/or in your Deck, except "Ragnaraika the Evil Seed", then banish 1 card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Insect, Plant, or Reptile monsters. You can only use this effect of "Ragnaraika the Evil Seed" once per turn.

cards.name: Tindangle Delaunay
cards.desc: When you take battle damage from an opponent's attacking monster, while you have 3 or more "Tindangle" monsters with different names in your GY: You can destroy the attacking monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Tindangle Acute Cerberus" from your Extra Deck. If you control no monsters in the Extra Monster Zone: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 3 "Tindangle" monsters with different names in your GY; Special Summon them in face-down Defense Position.

cards.name: Primite Fusion
cards.desc: Fusion Summon 1 Dragon Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling its materials from your field, GY, and/or banishment into the Deck, including a Normal Monster. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 Level 5 or higher "Primite" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Primite Fusion" once per turn.

cards.name: EXTINGUISH!
cards.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Rescue-ACE" card.)
If you control a "Rescue-ACE" monster: Target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; destroy it, then, if you currently control "Rescue-ACE Hydrant", your opponent cannot activate the effects of that destroyed monster, or of monsters with its same original name, this turn.

cards.name: Sextet Summon
cards.desc: Banish from your hand, GY, and/or face-up field, 6 monsters (1 each Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum, and Link), each with the same original Type, then Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck or Extra Deck, with the same original Type as those banished monsters. You can only activate 1 "Sextet Summon" per turn.

cards.name: Kozaky
cards.desc: A workaholic fiend who devotes everything to his research into the languages of Dark World. His mind has collapsed because of working too hard.

cards.name: Spiritual Energy Settle Machine
cards.desc: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, all Spirit monsters remain face-up on the field and do not return to their owners' hands during the End Phase even if they are Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. Discard 1 card from your hand during each of your End Phases. If you do not, destroy this card. When this card is removed from the field, all face-up Spirit monsters return to the owners' hands.

cards.name: Maiden of Blue Tears
cards.desc: If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) and you control a Link Monster (except during the Damage Step): Target 1 of them; destroy it, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its original ATK. If effect damage is inflicted while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 Normal Spell in your GY or banishment; Set it, but it cannot be activated this turn. You can only use 1 "Maiden of Blue Tears" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Infernity Archfiend
cards.desc: When you draw this card, if you have no other cards in your hand: You can reveal this card; Special Summon this card from your hand. When this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Infernity" card from your Deck to your hand. You must have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

cards.name: Nekroz of Clausolas
cards.desc:
You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Nekroz" Ritual Spell. Must be Ritual Summoned. You can only use each of these effects of "Nekroz of Clausolas" once per turn.
● You can discard this card; add 1 "Nekroz" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.
● (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; until the end of this turn, that target's ATK becomes 0, also that target's effects are negated.

cards.name: The Huge Revolution is Over
cards.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that would destroy 2 or more cards on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, banish it.

cards.name: Arcana Call
cards.desc: Select 1 "Arcana Force" monster you control. Remove from play 1 "Arcana Force" monster from either player's Graveyard. Until the End Phase, the selected monster's effect becomes the removed monster's effect for the same coin toss result.

cards.name: Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean
cards.desc: While you control a monster, except "Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean", your opponent's monsters cannot target this card for attacks. You can only use each of the following effects of "Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean" once per turn. You can send 1 other WATER monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Atlantean" or "Mermail" monster from your Deck to the GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; return it to the hand.

cards.name: S-Force Origin
cards.desc: Special Summon 1 "S-Force" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment, but banish it when it leaves the field. If another card is banished, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; take 2 "S-Force" cards from your Deck, except "S-Force Origin", banish 1 of them, and send the other to the GY. You can only use each effect of "S-Force Origin" once per turn.

cards.name: White Dragon Ninja
cards.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned, except with a "Ninjitsu Art" card's effect. Spells/Traps you control cannot be destroyed by card effects.

cards.name: Steelswarm Sentinel
cards.desc: While this card is in face-up Attack Position, Special Summoned Level 5 or higher monsters on the field cannot activate their effects.

cards.name: Paladins of Bonds and Unity
cards.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters with 2500 original ATK & DEF
While this Synchro Summoned card is in your Monster Zone, your opponent cannot target it with card effects, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. While you have 25 or more cards in your GY, this Synchro Summoned card gains 100 ATK/DEF for each card on the field and in the GYs. Once per turn, when a Spell Card is activated, while your opponent has 25 or more cards in their GY (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

cards.name: Gimmick Puppet Cattle Scream
cards.desc:
You can detach 1 material from an Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Gimmick Puppet Cattle Scream" once per turn. A "Gimmick Puppet" Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains this effect.
● Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your opponent's field in Defense Position.

cards.name: White Dragon Wyverburster
cards.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 DARK monster from your GY. You can only Special Summon "White Dragon Wyverburster" once per turn this way. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Black Dragon Collapserpent" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Synchro Overtake
cards.desc: Reveal 1 Synchro Monster in your Extra Deck, choose 1 of the Synchro Materials mentioned on it, and add to your hand or Special Summon that monster, from your Deck or GY, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this card, except Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Synchro Overtake" per turn.

cards.name: Union Driver
cards.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. While this card is equipped to a monster: You can banish this Equip Card; equip 1 Level 4 or lower appropriate Union monster from your Deck to the monster this card was equipped to. You can only use this effect of "Union Driver" once per turn.

cards.name: Dark Rabbit
cards.desc: He leaps up, down, and all around! Nobody can lay a hand on this funny bunny.

cards.name: Chaos Space
cards.desc: Send 1 LIGHT or DARK monster from your hand to the GY; add 1 LIGHT or DARK monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck to your hand, with a Level from 4 to 8, and with a different Attribute than that monster. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 of your banished LIGHT or DARK monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set; place that monster on the bottom of the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Chaos Space" once per turn.

cards.name: Five-Headed Dragon
cards.desc:
5 Dragon monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Cannot be destroyed by battle with a DARK, EARTH, WATER, FIRE, or WIND monster.

cards.name: Crystron Impact
cards.desc: Target 1 of your banished "Crystron" monsters; Special Summon it, and if you do, if your opponent controls any face-up monsters, change their DEF to 0. During either player's turn, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard, when a card or effect is activated that targets a "Crystron" monster you control: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate that effect.

cards.name: Avatar of The Pot
cards.desc: By sending 1 "Pot of Greed" from your hand to the Graveyard, draw 3 cards from your Deck.

cards.name: Tales of the White Forest
cards.desc: If you control an Illusion or Spellcaster monster: Add 1 "White Forest" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY to activate a monster effect: You can Set this card. You can only use each effect of "Tales of the White Forest" once per turn.

cards.name: Horus the Black Flame Deity
cards.desc: If you control a "Horus" monster and "King's Sarcophagus": You can reveal this card in your hand, then send 1 card from your hand or field to the GY; send 1 card on the field to the GY. If a face-up "Horus" monster(s) you control, except "Horus the Black Flame Deity", or a face-up "King's Sarcophagus" you control, leaves the field by an opponent's card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can send all other monsters on the field to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Horus the Black Flame Deity" once per turn.

cards.name: Oath of Companionship
cards.desc: If you control no monsters that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; take control of it until the End Phase. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this card.

cards.name: Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea
cards.desc: Show 1 "Nerva the Power Patron of Creation", 1 "Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction", and 1 "Junora the Power Patron of Tuning" from your Extra Deck, face-up Monster Zone, and/or GY, and if you do, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of your "Power Patron" monster effects this turn. If you would banish the top card(s) of your Deck to activate the effect of a "Power Patron" monster you control, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea" once per turn.

cards.name: The Phantom Knights of Cloven Helm
cards.desc: If a "Phantom Knights" card(s) is sent to your GY: This card gains 500 ATK. You can banish this card from your GY; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 "Phantom Knights" card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Cloven Helm" once per turn.

cards.name: Ice Knight
cards.desc: Gains 400 ATK for each Aqua monster you control. Once per turn: You can activate this effect; you can Normal Summon 1 WATER monster during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn), also you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters.

cards.name: Interrupted Kaiju Slumber
cards.desc: Destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, then Special Summon in Attack Position, 2 "Kaiju" monsters with different names from your Deck (1 on each side), but they cannot change their battle positions, and must attack, if able. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Kaiju" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Interrupted Kaiju Slumber" per turn.

cards.name: Code A Ancient Ruins
cards.desc: Each time a face-up "Alien" monster(s) is destroyed, place 1 A-Counter on this card. Once per turn, you can remove 2 A-Counters from anywhere on the field to Special Summon 1 "Alien" monster from your Graveyard.

cards.name: Valkyrian Knight
cards.desc: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up Warrior-Type monsters for attacks, except "Valkyrian Knight". When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can banish 1 Warrior-Type monster and this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Level 5 or higher Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

cards.name: The Secret of the Bandit
cards.desc: This card can only be activated during Main Phase 1. Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Each time the selected monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points this turn, your opponent discards 1 random card.

cards.name: D Cubed
cards.desc:
If this card is Normal Summoned: It is also treated as a "Destiny HERO" monster while face-up on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "D Cubed" once per turn.
● You can discard up to 2 cards; Special Summon "D Cubed" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, equal to the number discarded, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal or Special Summon other monsters, except "Destiny HERO" monsters.
● If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can send 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to the GY.

cards.name: Lightpulsar Dragon
cards.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. You can Special Summon this card (from your GY) by sending 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your hand to the GY. When this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can target 1 Level 5 or higher DARK Dragon monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

cards.name: Ghost Sleeper, the Underworld Princess
cards.desc: If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 "Ghost Fusion" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish this card and discard 1 card, then target 1 of your banished Level 4 or higher Zombie monsters; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Ghost Sleeper, the Underworld Princess" once per turn.

cards.name: Cipher Bit
cards.desc: Target 1 "Galaxy-Eyes" or "Cipher" Xyz Monster you control; attach this card to it as an Xyz Material, and if you do, the next time it would be destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, it is not destroyed.

cards.name: Crimson Call
cards.desc: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Fiend monster from your GY to your hand, or if you control "Red Dragon Archfiend" or a Synchro Monster that mentions it, you can add 1 such monster from your Deck instead. At the end of the Damage Step, if your "/Assault Mode" monster or "Red Dragon Archfiend" attacked: You can banish this card from your GY; the attacking monster can make a second attack in a row. You can only activate 1 "Crimson Call" per turn.

cards.name: Elemental Mistress Doriado
cards.desc: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Doriado's Blessing". The Attribute of this card is also treated as WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH while it is face-up on the field.

cards.name: Dinomorphia Brute
cards.desc: Pay half your LP; destroy 1 "Dinomorphia" monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls. When your opponent activates a card or effect, while your LP are 2000 or less: You can banish this card from your GY; you take no effect damage from your opponent's card effects this turn. You can only activate 1 "Dinomorphia Brute" per turn.

cards.name: Shiranui Spiritmaster
cards.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Shiranui" monster from your hand or GY, except "Shiranui Spiritmaster", but banish it when it leaves the field. If this card is banished: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Shiranui Spiritmaster" once per turn.

cards.name: Magikey Maftea
cards.desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Magikey" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material, OR Ritual Summon 1 "Magikey" Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. If you control a Normal Monster, you can also send 1 Normal Monster from your Deck to the GY as material or Tribute.

cards.name: Beastking of the Swamps
cards.desc: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster. When you do this, the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be the correct one(s).

cards.name: Cyber Angel Natasha
cards.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Machine Angel Ritual". Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; gain LP equal to half its ATK. When a Ritual Monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can negate the attack. If this card is in the Graveyard: You can banish 1 other "Cyber Angel" monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; Special Summon this card, and if you do, take control of that monster.

cards.name: Sylvan Guardioak
cards.desc: Once per turn: You can choose a number from 1 to 3, then excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, send any excavated Plant-Type monsters to the Graveyard, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can target 1 other Plant-Type monster in your Graveyard; place that target on the top of your Deck.

cards.name: Dramaturge of Despia
cards.desc: If a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Effect Monster on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn. If this card in your hand or field is used as Fusion Material, and sent to the GY or banished: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Dramaturge of Despia" once per turn.

cards.name: Reign-Beaux, Overlord of Dark World
cards.desc: If this card is discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls OR all Spell/Trap Cards they control.

cards.name: Full Armored Crystalzero Lancer
cards.desc:
3 Level 6 WATER monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a Rank 5 WATER Xyz Monster you control as the Xyz Material. (Xyz Materials attached to that monster also become Xyz Materials on this card.) This card gains 500 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to it. If this face-up card would be destroyed, you can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card instead. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; all face-up monsters your opponent controls have their effects negated until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Crystron Tristaros
cards.desc: When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 "Crystron" monster from your Deck, except "Crystron Tristaros", then immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Machine Synchro Monster using monsters you control, including that monster. You can banish this card from your GY; destroy 1 Synchro Monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Crystron" monsters from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Machine monsters. You can only use each effect of "Crystron Tristaros" once per turn.

cards.name: Bingo!
Lord of the Lamp
cards.desc: This spirit emerges from the mystic lamp and obeys the wishes of its summoner.

cards.name: The Spell Absorbing Life
cards.desc: Flip all face-down Defense Position Monster Cards on the field face-up. Flip Effects are not activated at this time. Increase your Life Points by 400 points for each Effect Monster Card on the field.

cards.name: Restructer Revolution
cards.desc: Inflict 200 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each card in your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter
cards.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or lower monster (Spellcaster or Warrior). You can only Special Summon "Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter" once per turn this way. The first time this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Twice per turn, each time your opponent draws a card(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card, or if your opponent drew by their own card effect, you draw the same number of cards instead. While you have 6 or more cards in your hand, negate all your opponent's activated Spell Cards and effects.

cards.name: Gravekeeper's Stele
cards.desc: Target 2 "Gravekeeper's" monsters in your GY; add those targets to your hand. This effect cannot be negated by the effect of "Necrovalley".

cards.name: Keaf, Murk of the Ghoti
cards.desc: If a Fish monster is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of those monsters and 1 of your banished Level 6 or lower Fish monsters; banish both that opponent's monster and this card, and if you do, Special Summon your targeted monster. During the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was banished: You can Special Summon this banished card. You can only use each effect of "Keaf, Murk of the Ghoti" once per turn.

cards.name: Jurassic Power
cards.desc: All Dinosaur monsters you control gain 300 ATK. You can Normal Summon Level 5 or higher Dinosaur monsters without Tributing. You can send 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Dinosaur monster with 1200 DEF from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Jurassic Power" once per turn.

cards.name: Alien Mars
cards.desc: The effects of Effect Monsters with A-Counters are negated, except for "Alien Mars".

cards.name: Despia, Theater of the Branded
cards.desc: During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Level 8 or higher Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. If a face-up non-Fusion Fairy monster you control leaves the field by an opponent's card effect, or is destroyed by battle: You can target 1 Level 8 or higher Fusion Monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Despia, Theater of the Branded" once per turn.

cards.name: Sky Striker Maneuver - Afterburners!
cards.desc: If you control no monsters in your Main Monster Zone: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy it, then, if you have 3 or more Spells in your GY, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap on the field.

cards.name: Labyrinth Tank
cards.desc: "Giga-Tech Wolf" + "Cannon Soldier"

cards.name: Guard Penguin
cards.desc: When you take damage from a card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, gain LP equal to the damage you took.

cards.name: Red Supernova Dragon
cards.desc:
3 Tuners + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for each Tuner in your GY. Cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn, when your opponent's monster effect is activated, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect; banish this card, also banish all cards your opponent controls. Once per turn, during your next End Phase after this card was banished by its own effect: Special Summon this banished card.

cards.name: Treacherous Trap Hole
cards.desc: If you have no Trap Cards in your Graveyard: Target 2 monsters on the field; destroy those targets.

cards.name: Dragunity Corsesca
cards.desc: This effect can only be activated while this card is equipped to a monster. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle, you can add 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your Deck to your hand with the same Type and Attribute as the monster this card is equipped to.

cards.name: Malevolent Nuzzler
cards.desc: The equipped monster gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 LP; place this card on the top of your Deck.

cards.name: Earthbound Fusion
cards.desc: You can only activate this card during the Main Phase, unless a card is in a Field Zone. Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. During your Main Phase, if a card is in a Field Zone: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Earthbound" monster from your hand or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion or Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Earthbound Fusion" once per turn.

cards.name: Megalith Bethor
cards.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Megalith" card. You can discard this card; Ritual Summon 1 "Megalith" Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can target cards your opponent controls, up to the number of Ritual Monsters with different names in your GY; destroy them. You can only use each effect of "Megalith Bethor" once per turn.

cards.name: Abyss Actor - Funky Comedian
cards.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Abyss Actor" monster, then target 1 "Abyss Actor" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field).

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can make this card gain 300 ATK for each "Abyss Actor" monster you currently control, until the end of this turn. You can target 1 other "Abyss Actor" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to this card's current ATK, until the end of this turn. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated. You can only use this effect of "Abyss Actor - Funky Comedian" once per turn.
cards.pendDesc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Abyss Actor" monster, then target 1 "Abyss Actor" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field).

You can only use this effect of "Abyss Actor - Funky Comedian" once per turn.

cards.name: Sylvan Komushroomo
cards.desc: When this card is flipped face-up: You can choose a number from 1 to 5, then excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, send any excavated Plant-Type monsters to the Graveyard, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

cards.name: Gem-Knight Lapis
cards.desc: The best of friends with Lazuli, this soldier deeply cares about the well-being of her friends.

cards.name: Asleep at the Switch
cards.desc: When your opponent gains Life Points: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: Dragon Mastery
cards.desc: Each monster you control that is equipped with a "Dragunity" monster(s) gains 500 ATK. Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up monster you control, and equip it with 1 Dragon-Type "Dragunity" monster from your hand.

cards.name: Jinzo - Layered
cards.desc:
2 Level 6 monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase, but it cannot activate its effects or declare an attack. If a Trap is on the field: You can Tribute 1 monster, and if you do, destroy 1 face-up card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Jinzo - Layered" once per turn.

cards.name: Satellarknight Procyon
cards.desc: If this card is Summoned: You can send 1 "tellarknight" monster from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Satellarknight Procyon" once per turn.

cards.name: World Legacy Succession
cards.desc: Target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only activate 1 "World Legacy Succession" per turn.

cards.name: Shien's Footsoldier
cards.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Six Samurai" monster from your Deck.

cards.name: Gravekeeper's Vassal
cards.desc: Any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is treated as effect damage instead.

cards.name: Raidraptor - Noir Lanius
cards.desc: During your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 "Raidraptor" monster you control; add 1 "Raidraptor" monster with a different Level than that monster from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; increase or decrease the Levels of all "Raidraptor" monsters you currently control by 1. You can only use each effect of "Raidraptor - Noir Lanius" once per turn.

cards.name: Dokurorider
cards.desc: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Revival of Dokurorider". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

cards.name: XZ-Tank Cannon
cards.desc:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Z-Metal Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen
cards.desc:
2+ Beast, Beast-Warrior, and/or Winged Beast monsters
If this card is Special Summoned, or if another Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can banish 1 card on the field. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster from your Deck to your hand, whose Level is less than or equal to the number of your banished Beast, Beast-Warrior, and Winged Beast monsters. You can only use each effect of "Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen" once per turn.

cards.name: Stegocyber
cards.desc: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks while this card is in your Graveyard: You can pay 1000 LP; Special Summon this card, and if you do, you take no battle damage from that battle, but banish this card when it leaves the field (this is a Quick Effect). You can only use this effect of "Stegocyber" once per turn.

cards.name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
cards.desc: Negate all DARK monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

cards.name: Rescue Hedgehog
cards.desc: You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower monsters from your Deck with the same Type, Attribute, and Level as each other (1 Normal Monster and 1 Effect Monster), but their effects are negated, also destroy them during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Hedgehog" once per turn.

cards.name: Danger!? Tsuchinoko?
cards.desc: You can reveal this card in your hand; your opponent randomly chooses 1 card from your entire hand, then you discard the chosen card. Then, if the discarded card was not "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?", Special Summon 1 "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?" from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card. If this card is discarded: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?" once per turn.

cards.name: Legendary Fiend
cards.desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 700 ATK.

cards.name: Meteor Rush - Monochroid
cards.desc: During the Battle Phase, if 5 or more attacks have been declared this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Meteor Rush - Monochroid" once per turn. If this card battles, it gains 1000 ATK for each attack declared this turn, during the Damage Step only.

cards.name: Ars Magna the Division and the Union
cards.desc: You can banish this card from your hand; Special Summon 1 non-Spellcaster "Ars Magna" monster from your GY or banishment, also your "Power Patron" Link Monsters can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. If a Synchro or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can banish 1 "Ars Magna" card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Division and the Union" once per turn.

cards.name: Alpha The Magnet Warrior
cards.desc: ''Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.''

cards.name: Blasting Fuse
cards.desc: Activate only when all zones of this card's column are occupied. Destroy all cards in this column.

cards.name: Dark Magic Curtain
cards.desc: Pay half your LP; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your Deck. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

cards.name: Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Foe
cards.desc: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Dream Mirror" monster: This card can attack directly this turn. During the Main or Battle Phase, if "Dream Mirror of Joy" is in a Field Zone (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Friend" from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Foe" once per turn.

cards.name: Ghostrick Mansion
cards.desc: Monsters cannot attack face-down Defense Position monsters, but can attack directly if all monsters their opponent controls are face-down Defense Position. All effect damage, and battle damage inflicted by monsters other than "Ghostrick" monsters, is halved.

cards.name: Sari of the Silverwing Axe
cards.desc: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card from your hand or field to it. It gains 100 ATK/DEF. You can only use this effect of "Sari of the Silverwing Axe" once per turn.

cards.name: Submarineroid
cards.desc: This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can change this card to Defense Position.

cards.name: Wind Effigy
cards.desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WIND Normal Monster.

cards.name: Gravekeeper's Cannonholder
cards.desc: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder"; inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Marincess Pascalus
cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Marincess" monster from your hand in Defense Position, except "Marincess Pascalus". During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Pascalus" once per turn.

cards.name: Trickstar Bouquet
cards.desc: Target 1 "Trickstar" monster you control and 1 face-up monster on the field; return that "Trickstar" monster to the hand, and if you do, the other monster gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the returned monster, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Trickstar Bouquet" per turn.

cards.name: Skull Flame
cards.desc: Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 "Burning Skull Head" from your hand. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. You can add 1 "Burning Skull Head" from your Graveyard to your hand instead of conducting a normal draw in your Draw Phase.

cards.name: Chow Chow Chan
cards.desc: When your opponent activates a Normal Trap Card in response to your monster's attack declaration targeting an opponent's monster: You can discard this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card (this is a Quick Effect).

cards.name: Mokey Mokey Adrift
cards.desc: This card's name becomes "Mokey Mokey" and is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. You can discard this card; add 1 "Mokey Mokey" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Mokey Mokey Adrift".

cards.name: Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra
cards.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or GY) by Tributing 1 monster on either player's field with a Predator Counter. You can only Special Summon "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn this way. If this card is on the field or in your GY (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 other "Predaplant" monster from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn.

cards.name: Naturia Exterio
cards.desc:
"Naturia Beast" + "Naturia Barkion"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While this card is face-up on the field, you can negate the activation of a Spell/Trap Card, and destroy it, by removing from play 1 card from your Graveyard, then sending the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.

cards.name: Adamancipator Friends
cards.desc: Excavate the top cards of your Deck equal to the number of Rock monsters you control +5, and if you do, you can add to your hand 1 excavated Rock monster with a Level equal to or lower than the number of the excavated cards, also place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except Rock monsters.

cards.name: Mudora the Sword Oracle
cards.desc: You can discard 1 other EARTH Fairy monster; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can place 1 "Gravekeeper's Trap" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your field or GY, then target up to 3 cards in any GY(s), or up to 5 if "Exchange of the Spirit" is on your field or in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Mudora the Sword Oracle" once per turn.

cards.name: T.G. Star Guardian
cards.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner "T.G." monsters
Once per Chain, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "T.G. Star Guardian" once per turn.
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "T.G." monster in your GY; add it to your hand.
● During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "T.G." monster from your hand.

cards.name: Frost Blast of the Monarchs
cards.desc: If you control a monster with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it. You can banish this card and 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it.

cards.name: Darklord Dance
cards.desc: Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fairy Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing monsters from your hand, field, and/or GY as material. The monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 1000 ATK. If Summoning a "Darklord" Fusion Monster this way, you can also use "Darklord" monsters your opponent controls as material. You can only activate 1 "Darklord Dance" per turn.

cards.name: Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing
cards.desc: When this card you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Yang Zing" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing". You can only use this effect of "Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing" once per turn. Once per turn, during your opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster, using only "Yang Zing" monsters you control (this is a Quick Effect). Possession of a Synchro Monster on the field that used this card as a Synchro Material cannot switch.

cards.name: RESCUE!
cards.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Rescue-ACE" card.)
Target 1 "Rescue-ACE" monster in your GY, or if you control "Rescue-ACE Hydrant", you can target 1 monster in your opponent's GY instead; Special Summon it to your field. You can only activate 1 "RESCUE!" per turn.

cards.name: Fiendsmith in Paradise
cards.desc: Target 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Fiend monster you control; send all cards on the field to the GY that are not that monster. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; send 1 "Fiendsmith" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Fiendsmith in Paradise" once per turn.

cards.name: Raijin the Breakbolt Star
cards.desc:
1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT Warrior monster + 1 EARTH Warrior monster
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card battles a monster without a Level, any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is doubled. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle or card effect and sent there this turn: You can target 2 Level 7 or lower Warrior monsters in your GY; Special Summon them. You can only use this effect of "Raijin the Breakbolt Star" once per turn.

cards.name: Recycling Batteries
cards.desc: Target 2 Thunder-Type monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

cards.name: Ojamandala
cards.desc: Pay 1000 Life Points. Special Summon 1 "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Graveyard.

cards.name: Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel
cards.desc: Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either effect, except Fusion Monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add up to 2 "Cubic" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord
cards.desc:
1 "Cubic" monster + "Vijam the Cubic Seed"
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from your hand and/or field to the GY. Gains 800 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

cards.name: Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord
cards.desc:
3 "Cubic" monsters
Gains 1000 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 3 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

cards.name: Divine Anima Infinity the Creation Cubic Overlord
cards.desc:
4 "Cubic" monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 1500 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle all your banished "Cubic" cards into the Deck, and if you do, destroy 1 card your opponent controls. If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon up to 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" from your GY.

cards.name: Cubic Bodhi
cards.desc: When this card is activated: You can send 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to the GY. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; place 1 Cubic Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls (monsters with a Cubic Counter cannot attack, also negate their effects). If a "Cubic" monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only activate 1 "Cubic Bodhi" per turn.

cards.name: Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils
cards.desc: If "Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye" or "Snake-Eyes Poplar" is in either GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn. You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela" from your GY; destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

cards.name: Wicked Canon
cards.desc: Each time an opponent's monster declares an attack, place 1 Sinister Doctrine Counter on this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Wicked Canon" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 DARK Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 Fiend monster. You can send this card with 4 or more Sinister Doctrine Counters to the GY; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your Deck, then you can add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Hope for the Future
cards.desc: If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster or "Elemental HERO Neos": Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions a "HERO" monster as material, using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Hope for the Future" once per turn.

cards.name: Fireworks Celebration
cards.desc: Activate this card by placing 5 Celebration Counters on it. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, and/or a card(s) is sent from the Deck to the GY, by a Spell/Trap effect: Remove 1 Celebration Counter from this card, then, if there are no Celebration Counters on it, destroy it, and if you do, gain 4000 LP, then Set 1 "Celebration" Trap from your Deck or GY, then, if you have 1 or less cards in your Deck, you win the Duel.

cards.name: Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~
cards.desc: You cannot activate the following effects of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" in the same Chain. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; move that monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card and you control 3 or more "Elvennotes" monsters: You can negate that effect, then if you control a Synchro Monster, you can destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" once per turn.

cards.name: Mercurium the Living Quicksilver
cards.desc:
2+ Level 10 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can attach 1 monster from your Deck to this card as material. You can only use this effect of "Mercurium the Living Quicksilver" once per turn. While this card has material, your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters in their GY with the same Attribute as a monster in your GY. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Detach 1 material from this card or take 3000 damage.

cards.name: Elvennotes Regina
cards.desc: (Quick Effect): You can send 1 other "Elvennotes" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned to the center Main Monster Zone: You can Special Summon 1 "Elvennotes" monster from your Deck, except "Elvennotes Regina". If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Elvennotes Regina" once per turn.

cards.name: Tigress in Silent Repose
cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that card when this card leaves the field. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Tigress in Silent Repose" once per turn.

cards.name: Just Flip a Coin
cards.desc:
If a face-up card(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, Special Summon 1 monster from your GY. If you call it wrong, Set 1 Trap from your GY. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 monster from your GY.
● Set 1 Trap from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Just Flip a Coin" once per turn.

cards.name: Kerolia the Frolicsome
cards.desc: If a Spell/Trap(s) on the field is returned to the hand (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when that card was returned) or hand (even if not), in face-up or face-down Defense Position, but if you Summoned it from the GY, banish it when it leaves the field. If another card(s) on the field is returned to the hand, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of your banished Normal Traps; Set it. You can only use each effect of "Kerolia the Frolicsome" once per turn.

cards.name: Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer
cards.desc:
2 WATER monsters
You can send 1 card you control to the GY; all WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF this turn. If a WATER Link Monster(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of those destroyed monsters; Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand or GY, with a Level less than or equal to that monster's Link Rating. You can only use each effect of "Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer" once per turn.

cards.name: Chaospawn Bishop
cards.desc: If this card you control would be used as Synchro Material, you can treat it as a non-Tuner. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Chaospawn Bishop" from your hand, Deck, or GY, and if you do, it becomes LIGHT, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon, except LIGHT or DARK monsters, and you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Chaospawn Bishop" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Castellan
cards.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column, or 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone that is 2 columns away from this card's; banish that card. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can send 1 "Angelechy" card from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Castellan" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each player can only activate 1 card or effect per Chain.

cards.name: Angelechy Seneschal
cards.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: Activate this effect; each player can Special Summon 1 Fairy Synchro Monster from their Extra Deck (but negate its effects), also this card, and monsters Special Summoned by this effect, cannot be used as material for an Xyz or Link Summon, and return them to the Extra Deck when they leave the field. If an "Angelechy" monster targets this card for an attack: Negate that attack, and if you do, give control of this card to your opponent. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Seneschal" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Strategy Score
cards.desc: Add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Strategy Score", also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Strategy Score" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Brilliant Move
cards.desc: Return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can banish this card from your GY, then send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Brilliant Move" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Opposition
cards.desc: Choose 2 "Angelechy" monsters in your Extra Deck, with different names than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, Special Summon 1 of them in your opponent's Main Monster Zone, and place the other in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can banish this card from your GY; shuffle up to 5 "Angelechy" cards into the Deck from your GY and/or banishment, except "Angelechy Opposition". You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this card, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Angelechy Opposition" per turn.

cards.name: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
cards.desc: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

cards.name: Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God
cards.desc: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God", then if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, you can discard 1 random card from their hand. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God
cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God
cards.desc: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God
cards.desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest
cards.desc: If you control a "Winter Raven" card, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card or 1 Level 7 or 8 Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it to your field.

cards.name: Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.desc: You can send 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY; place this card face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon up to 2 "Winter Raven" monsters with different names from each other from your Deck, except "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven". When a monster declares an attack and this card is a Continuous Spell: You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.desc: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Winter Raven" monster you control; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". You can only use each effect of "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest
cards.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by placing 1 Level 1 FIRE Monster Card from your face-up field or GY on the bottom of the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the hand, then target 1 monster in the face-up field or either GY; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. You can only use this effect of "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn.

cards.name: Salamangreat Markhor
cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as material for a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE Cyberse monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Markhor" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except FIRE monsters.

cards.name: Salamangreat Bastella
cards.desc: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Salamangreat" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can increase or decrease the Level of 1 monster on the field by 1. If you Link Summon a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Set 1 "Salamangreat" Trap from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Bastella" once per turn.

cards.name: Bunnillin: Mocha MOD
cards.desc: You can send 1 Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Bunnillin" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY face-up on your field. If your oppoennt Special Summons an Effect Monster(s), while this card is in the Monster Zone: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Bunnillin: Mocha MOD" once per turn.

cards.name: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor
cards.desc: During your opponent's End Phase: You can place this card from your GY on top of the Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand, and if you do, each player draws 1 card, then your opponent can draw 1 card, and if they do, you must keep your hand revealed during this Main Phase. (Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Amurusa
cards.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 non-WIND "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Amurusa" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Luvian
cards.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 "Reindsurm" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Luvian" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Carcasas
cards.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can send 2 "Reindsurm" cards from your Deck to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Carcasas" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Gigalovendra
cards.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". (Quick Effect): You can send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, including this card; add 1 non-FIRE "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Ritual Summoned, or your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can shuffle up to 2 monsters on the field into the Deck. If this card and a WATER "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Gigalovendra" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Giriakarma
cards.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". When your opponent activates a monster effect in the field or GY and you control this Ritual Summoned card (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, then you can shuffle 1 monster each from both your opponent's field and GY into the Deck, also if either of them was a Dragon monster, double this card's ATK. If this card and a LIGHT "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Giriakarma" once per turn.

cards.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra, Sun God of Darkness
cards.desc:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

cards.name: Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God
cards.desc:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

cards.name: Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest
cards.desc:
1 Fusion or Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster or Illusion monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can place any number of monsters you control face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Spells, then you can return cards on the field to the hand up to the number of Spells/Traps you control. You can only use this effect of "Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. Gains 700 ATK/DEF for each Spell/Trap on the field. This face-up Fusion Summoned card cannot be used as Fusion Material.

cards.name: Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.desc:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck.
● Extra Deck: Add 1 "Winter Raven" card from your GY to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.desc:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck.
● Extra Deck: Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: The Immortal Sun God
cards.desc: Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your GY or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then if you Special Summoned "The Winged Dragon of Ra" by this effect, you can send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Extra Deck. During the End Phase, send the monsters Special Summoned by this effect to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Sun God" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Immortal Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
cards.desc: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Conquest
cards.desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any number of Insect Ritual Monsters. You must also shuffle Insect and/or Dragon monsters from the GY(s) into the Deck whose total Levels equal or exceed the total Levels of the Ritual Monsters. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Insect monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Conquest" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Carnation
cards.desc: While you control a "Reindsurm" monster whose original Level is 8 or higher or your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, the activated effects of your "Reindsurm" monsters cannot be negated. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Reindsurm" monster or Dragon monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original Level, but a different original name.

cards.name: Reindsurm Butterfly
cards.desc: Send 2 monsters from your Deck to the GY, including an Insect monster, also you cannot Special Summon until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, except Insect monsters. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; all "Reindsurm" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK/DEF. You can only use 1 "Reindsurm Butterfly" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Practice
cards.desc: Add 2 "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then if your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, you can add 1 Insect monster from your GY to your hand. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; place 1 "Reindsurm" Field Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Practice" once per turn.

cards.name: Deep Forest of the Winter Raven
cards.desc: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your Deck to your hand. "Winter Raven" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" per turn.

cards.name: Salamangreat Gearblade
cards.desc: Special Summon 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your hand or GY, and if you do, equip this card to it. You can send 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your Deck to the GY; the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the sent monster's Level x 300. If this card is in your GY: You can shuffle 3 "Salamangreat" cards from your GY into the Deck, except Equip Spells, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gearblade" once per turn.

cards.name: Bunnillin Extract
cards.desc: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Extract" once per turn. If a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

cards.name: Autumn
cards.desc: This card's name becomes "Summer" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY that you can place a Season Counter on, except "Autumn", and place it face-up on your field, and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card. If a card(s) in the Field Zone would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

cards.name: Sun God Domination
cards.desc:
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster is on the field: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 monster from each GY to your field.
● If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is on the field, take control of all monsters your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster; gain LP equal to the ATK it had on the field. You can only use each effect of "Sun God Domination" once per turn.

cards.name: Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God
cards.desc:
Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster by this effect during your opponent's turn, you can Special Summon it.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
You can only activate 1 "Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God" per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Encounter
cards.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Reindsurm" monster: Negate the activation, then you can add 1 "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, and if you do, send 1 Insect monster you control to the GY. If a "Reindsurm" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can place this card from your GY on the bottom of the Deck instead. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Encounter" once per turn.

cards.name: Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch
cards.desc:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Diabell" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using up to 1 "Winter Raven" monster each from your hand, Extra Deck, and/or field.
● If you control a "Diabell" monster: Target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch" once per turn.

cards.name: Illusion of the Winter Raven Witch
cards.desc: Fusion Summon 1 Illusion Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Extra Deck and/or field, also you cannot activate monster effects in the hand or GY for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Illusion monsters'. If the activation of this card in its owner's possession was negated by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: You can Set this card, and if you do, return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only activate 1 "llusion of the Winter Raven Witch" per turn.

cards.name: Bunnillin Soft
cards.desc: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, Normal Monsters you control gain 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Soft" once per turn. You can target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY with different Types, Attributes, and Levels; Special Summon them. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Get Your Game On!
